IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+

recordedFacts.title: Executive Master Of Business Administration In Human Resource Management
recordedFacts.description: The Executive MBA in Human Resource Management equips participants with advanced skills in leadership, strategy, and talent optimization. This program covers critical HR frameworks, decision-making models, and innovative practices for aligning HR with organizational goals. Students will gain global perspectives on talent acquisition, reward management, and employee engagement. Emphasis is placed on addressing workplace conflicts and ensuring compliance with employment laws. Participants will also develop strategic capabilities to navigate complex business environments and lead impactful organizational change.The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
entryRequirements: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
recordedFacts.workshops: Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.
recordedFacts.visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
